title: IdpSamlConfig
description: SAML configuration. Provide idpMetadataUrl OR the manual triple (idpEntityId, idpSsoUrl, idpCertificate).

idpMetadataUrl.description: URL to fetch IdP metadata (mutually exclusive with manual triple).

idpCertificate.description: X.509 certificate (PEM) used to validate SAMLResponses (manual).

groupsAttributeName.description: SAML attribute name that contains groups.

rolesAttributeName.description: Optional SAML attribute name that contains roles.

acsUrl.description: Assertion Consumer Service URL provided to the IdP.

allowIdpInitiated.description: Allow IdP-initiated SSO (SAMLResponse posted to ACS without a preceding SP request).

clockSkewSeconds.description: Allowed clock skew when validating assertions.
